summary: Iteration 7 (Branding + School Invite Codes + NEP explainer + Indian imagery). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests pass — PUT/GET /api/university/branding (RBAC 403 for non-univ), GET /api/branding/for-school/Demo Public School returns seeded university branding (logo_url + headline_color + tagline + university_name='Panjab University Career Cell'), non-existent/system school returns all-null shape. Invite lifecycle: create (8-char uppercase alphanum code) → list → public GET (no auth) → accept (creates user with invite role+school, returns token) → second accept 400 'already been used' → subsequent public GET 400 → revoke removes it (404 afterward). Non-university roles get 403 on create. Frontend: Landing NEP section renders with 4 pillar cards + 'How Pathfinder AI helps' callout + Indian-classroom hero image; nav-university-branding link present; /university/branding page loads (brand-logo-url, brand-color, brand-tagline, brand-save) and persists across reload; /university/schools shows univ-invite-btn-{id} on each card, modal exposes invite-role-principal/counselor + invite-generate-btn, generation surfaces invite-link with full URL; anonymous /invite/{code} in a fresh context renders invite-name/email/password inputs, submission auto-logs-in as principal and redirects to /principal; student report shows brand-banner (data-testid) at top with 'Powered by Panjab University Career Cell' + tagline 'India Ka Career Compass' for seed student's Demo Public School results; RBAC redirects student away from /university/branding to /dashboard.

minor.issue: No dedicated test for a school whose created_by == 'system' (seed upserts Demo Public School to university id on boot, so this branch was covered indirectly via a random non-existent school which hits the same null-return branch). Fine functionally; consider inserting a system-owned fixture school for stronger coverage.
InviteAcceptInput.email is EmailStr; sending empty string would 422 with structured detail — frontend already uses formatApiErrorDetail so no crash.

issues: Recharts warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' still emitted (carried over from iter6). Add explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: (Optional) Silence Recharts width/height=-1 warnings by giving ResponsiveContainer a concrete min-height in UniversityDashboard.jsx.
(Optional) Add a Cypress/Playwright fixture that seeds a 'system'-owned school so the branding/for-school null-shape path is asserted explicitly (currently only exercised via a non-existent school).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1581 lines — university (branding + invites) endpoints are a natural module boundary; split into routers/university.py.
InviteAcceptInput enforces EmailStr but the accept endpoint does NOT normalise/strip whitespace or check password strength. Fine for MVP; add password policy later.
Invite `expires_at` is stored as ISO string; comparing via fromisoformat is fine but consider storing as native datetime for indexed TTL cleanup.
GET /api/branding/for-school/{name} uses path param — a school with a slash or unusual chars will 404 at the routing layer. Consider a query param or slugified lookup for robustness.

In UniversityBranding.jsx save() the catch swallows structured error detail (uses plain string). Since server returns JSON detail, formatApiErrorDetail should be used here too for parity with InviteAccept.jsx.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows verified: NEP explainer, branding CRUD+persistence, invite generate, anonymous invite accept → /principal redirect, student report brand-banner, RBAC)

test_credentials: Seed accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md used; test invitee emails are ephemeral 'test_invite_*@example.com' created via the accept endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created (a) new principal-invite users via /invite/{code}/accept and (b) an ephemeral counselor invite (revoked). Branding was left set to logo=https://example.com/logo.png, color=#0e4d92, tagline='India Ka Career Compass' at end of run so the report brand-banner keeps rendering the expected values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-7 endpoints are green. Backend base URL must be exported (export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2)) before running pytest, otherwise requests barfs with MissingSchema. Do NOT trigger /assessment/submit or /careers/explore for AI-budget reasons; reuse existing seed student's past report IDs from /api/results/me for report-page checks. Recharts width=-1 warnings on UniversityDashboard are still present (iter6 carryover).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in iteration 7.
